data.exact_reserve_text: As a result, the claims reserves were strengthened materially, in particular on the 2013 and prior years. During the year there was net adverse claims development of GBP 34.5 million on the 2013 and prior years and GBP 1.3 million on the 2014 year of account.

prior_year_events.event_name: Adverse development on 2013 and prior years (reserve strengthening)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Material strengthening of claims reserves following an independent review of open claims, driven by increases in incurred claims on professional indemnity, Directors & Officers and medical malpractice

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2526 materially strengthened its gross claims reserves during 2015, primarily for the 2013 and prior underwriting years. An independent review of open claims led to adverse re-estimation, driven largely by professional indemnity, Directors & Officers and medical malpractice business; the technical provisions show a gross prior-year strengthening of GBP 71.18m (c.52.8% of opening gross reserves). The report also notes net adverse development of GBP 34.5m on 2013 & prior (net of reinsurance).
raw_causal_phrases: claims reserves were strengthened materially, in particular on the 2013 and prior years
significant increase in the incurred claims position on the professional indemnity, Directors and Officers and medical malpractice classes of business
instigated a review of all open claims
net adverse claims development of GBP 34.5 million on the 2013 and prior years and GBP 1.3 million on the 2014 year of account
data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement taken from Technical Provisions reconciliation ('Changes for prior years' gross = GBP 71,180k). Narrative elsewhere quotes a 'net adverse' movement (GBP 34.5m) which is after reinsurance - both figures reported. LOB attribution (Professional Lines) is inferred from narrative stating professional indemnity, D&O and medical malpractice drove the deterioration; the technical note does not break the prior-year movement down by statutory class.
